class: Supported profile facts rejected by broad application categories
symptom: Application Questions repeatedly rejected Master's Degree and Immediately despite offering Post-Graduate Degree and Not Applicable for notice period.
root_cause: Shared option matching lacked one-way completed-degree categories; immediate availability had no context-bound no-notice fallback.
why_tests_missed: Degree matching fixtures used exact degree labels and availability fixtures did not combine a notice question with an N/A duration menu.
fix: Completed degrees can match broader completed categories, never the reverse or incomplete studies; immediate availability can match Not Applicable only for notice-period questions.
prevention: Test offered category semantics and actual committed selections using a synthetic profile.
